derivation: probably from the same as G1171 (δεινῶς) (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange);
def: so and so (when the person is not specified)

occurrences.text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
